findings.summary: Buyer asked if Royale Diamonds TikTok purchase was a scam after paying $1500. Commenters generally said likely legit but overpriced; one awaited delivery confirmation.
findings.notes: Reddit JSON API blocked from this environment; content from search snippets + prior public discussion.

findings.summary: Buyers quoted as receiving IGI reports with purchases; describes high-pressure auctions and final-sale terms rather than non-delivery fraud.
BBB warning about TruGala-style discount-code jewelry scam — not Royale Diamonds.
Negative Google-style reviews for a Pune jewelry store sharing the name.

pattern_assessment: Dominant public pattern is overpayment / auction psychology risk, not a corroborated non-fulfillment ring. No verified enforcement action against @royalediamondslive found.
